description: Burial-matched permutation test for purifying selection on the R3HDML CAP pocket lining, with PAE summary
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy import stats

per = pd.read_csv("work/r3hdml_per_residue.csv")
pk  = pd.read_csv("work/pocket_lining.csv")
pk["resid"] = pk.res.str[1:].astype(int)
per = per[per.entropy.notna()].copy()
per["in_pocket"] = per.resid.isin(pk.resid)

A = per[per.in_pocket]; B = per[~per.in_pocket]
u,p = stats.mannwhitneyu(A.entropy, B.entropy, alternative="less")
print("Pocket-lining vs rest: entropy  median %.3f vs %.3f ; Mann-Whitney U=%.0f p=%.2e" %
      (A.entropy.median(), B.entropy.median(), u, p))
print("  mean ortholog identity %.3f vs %.3f (n=%d vs %d)" % (A.identity.mean(), B.identity.mean(), len(A), len(B)))
print("  mean rSASA %.3f vs %.3f  <- pocket residues are more buried, so match on burial" % (A.rsasa.mean(), B.rsasa.mean()))

# rSASA-matched permutation test: for each pocket residue draw a non-pocket residue with closest rSASA
rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
obs = A.entropy.mean()
null = []
Bv = B[["rsasa","entropy"]].values
for _ in range(5000):
    picks=[]
    pool = Bv.copy()
    for rs in A.rsasa.values:
        d = np.abs(pool[:,0]-rs)
        k = np.flatnonzero(d <= np.partition(d,4)[4])          # 5 closest by burial
        j = k[rng.integers(len(k))]
        picks.append(pool[j,1])
    null.append(np.mean(picks))
null=np.array(null)
pperm = (np.sum(null<=obs)+1)/(len(null)+1)
print("\nBurial-matched permutation test (5000 draws):")
print("  observed mean entropy of pocket lining = %.3f" % obs)
print("  matched-null mean = %.3f (sd %.3f), 2.5-97.5%% = %.3f-%.3f" % (null.mean(), null.std(), *np.percentile(null,[2.5,97.5])))
print("  one-sided p = %.4f  (pocket more conserved than burial-matched residues)" % pperm)

# same test for the two conserved surface patches
patch1 = [150,153,155,158,167,212,213,216]; patch2=[80,224,226,234,236,239]
for nm,res in [("patch1 (CAP/tail junction)",patch1),("patch2 (tail)",patch2)]:
    Ai = per[per.resid.isin(res)]
    nn=[]
    for _ in range(5000):
        picks=[]
        for rs in Ai.rsasa.values:
            d=np.abs(Bv[:,0]-rs); k=np.flatnonzero(d<=np.partition(d,4)[4]); picks.append(Bv[k[rng.integers(len(k))],1])
        nn.append(np.mean(picks))
    nn=np.array(nn); o=Ai.entropy.mean()
    print("  %-28s obs=%.3f null=%.3f p=%.4f" % (nm, o, nn.mean(), (np.sum(nn<=o)+1)/(len(nn)+1)))

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(14,4.2))
ax=axes[0]
ax.scatter(per.rsasa, per.entropy, s=18, c=np.where(per.in_pocket,"#e53e3e","#a0aec0"),
           edgecolor="none", alpha=0.85)
ax.set_xlabel("relative solvent accessibility"); ax.set_ylabel("Shannon entropy across 143 orthologs")
ax.set_title("A  CAP pocket lining (red) is conserved\nat every level of burial", fontsize=10, loc="left")
ax=axes[1]
ax.hist(null, bins=40, color="#a0aec0"); ax.axvline(obs, color="#e53e3e", lw=2)
ax.set_xlabel("mean entropy of burial-matched residue sets"); ax.set_ylabel("permutations")
ax.set_title("B  Burial-matched permutation test\nobserved %.3f, p=%.4f" % (obs,pperm), fontsize=10, loc="left")
ax=axes[2]
pae_lab=["CAP internal","tail internal","CAP->tail","tail->CAP","propeptide->CAP"]
pae_val=[2.62,7.43,5.07,8.49,28.87]
ax.barh(pae_lab, pae_val, color=["#2b6cb0","#2b6cb0","#48bb78","#48bb78","#e53e3e"])
ax.set_xlabel("mean predicted aligned error (A)")
ax.set_title("C  AlphaFold PAE: the tail is placed on the CAP\ndomain, the propeptide is not", fontsize=10, loc="left")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
